correctness.rationale: The modal factorial formula, multinomial covariance geometry, uniform shifted-Gamma remainder, Bernoulli-polynomial coefficients, dimension-transition limits, and Gaussian unit-cell limit were checked analytically. The continuity-correction claim is limited to the stated unit cube and critical regime.

originality.rationale: The recent complete fixed-category modal expansion, the precise multinomial local limit theorem and jittered Gaussian comparison, and searches for growing-dimensional multinomial local limits were checked. No source was located stating the uniform growing-category modal expansion, correction hierarchy, and critical unit-cell profile together. Classical lattice expansions and central-multinomial factorial asymptotics are retained as residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies an exact square-root dimension barrier for modal Gaussian relative error, provides explicit higher-order corrections with successive dimension thresholds, and quantifies the effect and limitation of the standard multivariate continuity correction.

same_model_review.disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
